prompt:
A flat desktop web application screen, 1536x1024 landscape, rendered as a crisp UI screenshot: no device frame, no perspective, no photograph, no people. The app is "WebThrottle", the DCC-EX model railway Throttle, in its Control role. The interface is a modern Rail Operating Centre traffic-management workstation: a calm dark schematic on matte screens, a clean modern sans-serif with tabular numerals, thin precise linework, generous spacing, no skeuomorphism, no enamel tiles, no knobs, no levers.
Palette: ground #161b1f, panels #1e252a, idle track #5f6b73, set route white #eef2f4, occupied red #e5484d, train describer amber #f7b656, selection teal #00a3b9, stop red #d7263d.

Regions:
1. TOP BAR, thin: left the wordmark "WebThrottle" with a small "DCC-EX" tag; centre role tabs "Drive", "Points", "Control", "Diagnostics" with Control underlined in teal; right "Connected · USB" with a teal dot and "12:04".
2. SCHEMATIC, left 60% of the width and about 70% of the height, the dominant region: the layout drawn as a clean orthogonal signalling schematic using only straight lines and 45-degree diagonals: a main line with a passing loop above it and a two-road yard branching off to the lower right. Five turnouts labelled 1 to 5 with small white numbers; the set route through each is drawn in bright white, the unset leg in dim grey. One section is drawn red with the label "Platform 1 · Occupied". Two small amber train-describer tags sit on the track reading "37025" and "08648". A small grey caption in the schematic's bottom-left corner: "No diagram yet? Turnouts line up as route tiles until you draw one."
3. RIGHT COLUMN, 40% width, the loco desk for "37 025 · Class 37 · Address 3": a big tabular speed "42" set against a thin horizontal 0 to 126 scale with ticks, filled in teal to 42; a "REV | FWD" toggle with FWD in teal; a red "Stop" button. Below, a panel "Functions · 20" as a compact grid of twenty labelled keys, four columns by five rows: Headlight (active), Engine (active), Horn, Bell, Cab light, Ditch lights, Marker lights, Shunt mode, Momentum, Coupler, Pantograph, Uncouple, Brake squeal, Announcement, Smoke, Interior, Dynamo, Mute, F18, F19; active keys have a teal edge.
4. BOTTOM STRIP, full width: a red "STOP ALL" button at left, then power toggles "MAIN A  ON" and "MAIN B  ON", then an event line in small grey text "12:04  Loco 3 set to 42 by another Throttle  ·  12:03  Turnout 2 thrown".

Quiet, precise, legible under dim room light. All UI text must be spelled exactly as given.
